Name: Emyn's Pride March
Author: yishaqeni
Description:
[b]Brief Overview

[/b]This mod adds a small event where Stardew residents take part in a Pride march in town on Summer 1. All residents are given Pride flag themed leis, and have unique Pride dialogue for the day.

While the event can only occur once, every Summer 1 from then on in will have villagers in Pride flower garlands, with Pride themed dialogue.

[b]Version 1.1.0 now adds portrait pride flower garlands![/b] It also fixes an issue where Pride dialog would only show for the first pride, so redownload is recommended. :)

[b]Requirements:

- [/b]Stardew Valley 1.5+
- Content Patcher 1.23.0+
- SMAPI 3.12.6+

Compatible with Diverse Stardew Valley and Diverse Ginger Island.

[b]Recommended:

[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4312]George dialogue edits (no more homophobia and ableism) [/url]by infinity0001 - This mod adds a reference to George being bi, which doesn't mesh well with his homophobia if you marry Alex. This is recommended if you like continuity.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9771]Emyn's Queer Dialogue Expansion[/url] by gwenynnefydd (me!) - This also removes George's ableism, and also adds 4-5 strings per character that references queerness and queer culture.

[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal]Diverse Stardew Valley [/url]- this adds diversity to Stardew Valley, and has options to add sprites to support trans Sam and trans Penny dialogue.

[b]Install

[/b]Just drag and drop into your mod folder.
